title: Varicella 2-dose series complete for persons age 7-18 years without evidence of immunity

source.quote: Ensure persons age 7–18 years without evidence of immunity

grade: not graded (CDC/ACIP routine and catch-up schedule recommendation)
action: Ensure a 2-dose varicella-containing vaccine series (VAR or MMRV) has been received

uncomputable.needs: evidence of varicella immunity (documented disease history, laboratory evidence, or other ACIP immunity criteria)

derived.window: doses may be given any time from birth; the oldest patient in the denominator is 18, so a window starting 18 years before the measurement year covers any patient's whole lifetime
